planets.name: TOI-5624 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5624 with a 3.39-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-5624 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 5 planets known around TOI-5624. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BONFANTI_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2026, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 5; pl_orbper 3.3903473, pl_radj 0.20644161, pl_bmassj 0.02957571

quotes.title: TOI-5624 b
quotes.card: TOI-5624 b is the innermost and smallest exoplanet discovered in the TOI-5624 system, located approximately 331 light-years from Earth in the constellation Ursa Major.
quotes.introduction: The planet was confirmed in late April 2026 using the transit method.
